nyczips: superseded by nycmaps

nyczips-package.Rd

The objects this package used to provide, nyc_zip_sf (212 ZIP code tabulation areas) and nyc_zips (ZIP code to borough), are in the nycmaps package, with the same contents. Use nycmaps::nyc_zip_sf and nycmaps::nyc_zips. The nycmaps version of nyc_zip_sf is in EPSG:2263 (NAD83 / New York Long Island, ftUS); the copy formerly here was in EPSG:4269.

Details

The objects were removed so that loading both packages no longer masks one copy with the other.
